[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[The Dark Woman|An'ya Kuro]] constructed and wielded a '''purple-bladed lightsaber''' in her [[Jedi/Legends|career]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|member]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Kuro used the [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] in a [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] with her then&ndash;[[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Darth Krayt|A'Sharad Hett]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] after the latter came to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of his [[Sharad Hett|father]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], she briefly replaced the purple crystal in her weapon with a blue one. She would use it for the final [[Time/Legends|time]] in a [[Duel on Cophrigin V|duel]] with [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] in [[1 BBY/Legends|1 BBY]] on [[Cophrigin V]].
